description: Get the latest price for a symbol, or all symbols when none is given.

symbol.description: Optional trading pair symbol (e.g. BTCUSDT). When omitted, prices for all symbols are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a single {symbol, price} object or a list of them; on failure (invalid symbol), output contains an error message.

description: Get 24-hour rolling window price change statistics for a symbol, or all symbols.

symbol.description: Optional trading pair symbol. When omitted, stats for all symbols are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a single 24hr ticker object or a list; on failure (invalid symbol), output contains an error message.

description: Get the order book (bids and asks) for a symbol.

limit.description: Maximum number of price levels per side (default 100).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has lastUpdateId, bids and asks; on failure (invalid symbol), output contains an error message.

description: Get candlestick (kline) data for a symbol and interval.

limit.description: Maximum number of candles to return (default 500).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of candle arrays; on failure (invalid symbol), output contains an error message.

description: Get the spot account information, including balances and permissions.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the account object with commissions, flags and balances.
